title: Mono Basin roads: ordered, connected centrelines from OpenStreetMap by way ID, with ODbL attribution
phase: Phase 5 - Mono Basin corridor (moved ahead by ADR 0006)
forbidden_dependencies: Geometry from Google Maps or Street View
acceptance_criteria: DONE: FETCH: fetch_osm_roads.py asks Overpass for the 106 way IDs in data/reference/roads.geojson, records the query, endpoint, fetch time and OSM data timestamp in data/manifests/osm_roads.json, caches the raw response in data/raw/osm/ (gitignored). Way IDs OSM no longer has are listed (none missing on 2026-10-17).

DONE: CHECK TAGS: OSM ref, surface and maxspeed are compared with the reference per road; 9 disagreements are written to the manifest (for example Lundy Lake Road: reference says asphalt, OSM says unpaved).

DONE: ORDER: road_graph.order_ways joins ways through shared nodes into chains, split at junctions and dead ends; clip_polyline_to_box cuts them to the world box. Connectivity is by node identity, so a chain has no missing way. Vertex spacing on long straights can exceed 200 m (US-395 up to 1.2 km); that is not a gap and is handled by densifying along the spline in T-0105.
DONE: TESTS: 15 synthetic tests (shuffled and reversed ways, T junction, gap, loop, determinism, clipping) pass with the other world tests (33 in total).
DONE: ATTRIBUTION: docs/ATTRIBUTION.md has the credit lines and flags the ODbL share-alike question for the director.

DONE: REAL RUN: SR 120 is one 19.4 km line from Tioga Pass to the US-395 junction (plus a 0.08 km stub); US-395 is a 36.6 km line spanning the box north to south (plus two short side chains); SR 270 is 15.8 km and the Bodie gravel section 4.4 km; SR 167 is 18.9 km inside the box.
